# Diagnostics

Every code the compiler reports, and what to do about it. `kirana-style check` prints
`severity[CODE] name: message` with the location and a `help:` line; the help line is
specific to the case and wins over this table. Errors fail the build; warnings and infos
can be re-levelled in `kirana.config.*` under `diagnostics` (errors cannot).

Full page: https://kirana.style/docs/tooling/diagnostics.md

| Code | Name | Severity | What it means and what to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| KRN1001 | `parse-error` | error | The file does not parse. Fix the syntax; nothing in it compiles until it does. |
| KRN1101 | `not-evaluable` | error | A value the compiler must know at build time is not static (an argument read from a variable it cannot follow, a computed name). Write it out, or import it from a module the compiler can read. |
| KRN1102 | `unsupported-syntax` | error | The expression is valid JavaScript the evaluator does not run in a style (calling a non-function, applying a plain object as a style). Wrap style objects in `css()`; move logic out of the style. |
| KRN1103 | `unresolved-import` | warning | An import a style depends on did not resolve, so its value is treated as runtime. Check the specifier and `tsconfig` paths. |
| KRN1201 | `unknown-property` | error | Not a CSS property (a typo such as `colour`, or a Tailwind class name used as a key). Use the camelCase CSS property name. |
| KRN1202 | `invalid-value` | error | The value does not fit the property's grammar: a keyword it does not take (`padding: "red"`), a negative size, or a token of the wrong kind (a colour token on `padding`). The message gives the grammar. Words the data does not know, function arguments and `var()` are never judged. |
| KRN1203 | `unitless-length` | error | A bare number on a length property. Write the unit: `width: "5px"`, or a token. |
| KRN1204 | `unsplittable-shorthand` | warning | A shorthand whose value cannot be split into longhands (`border: var(--x)`) stays whole, so a later style cannot remove one longhand. Write the longhands. |
| KRN1205 | `mixed-logical-physical` | warning | Logical and physical longhands on one box (`paddingInlineStart` and `padding`) sit side by side instead of replacing each other. Use one family, preferably logical. |
| KRN1206 | `invalid-fallback` | error | A `firstThatWorks()` the browser would drop or misread: empty, nested, a runtime value, or values that set different longhands. Keep every value static and of the same shape. |
| KRN1207 | `fallback-on-variable` | warning | `firstThatWorks()` on a custom property: a variable never falls back, the last value always wins. Put the fallback where the variable is read: `var(--x, fallback)`. |
| KRN1208 | `invalid-position-try` | error | A property `@position-try` ignores. The block takes inset, margin, size, self-alignment, `positionAnchor` and `positionArea` only. |
| KRN1209 | `invalid-view-transition` | error | A `viewTransition()` key other than `group`, `imagePair`, `old`, `new`, or a condition other than `media()`/`supports()` on a part. |
| KRN1210 | `invalid-counter-style` | error | A `counterStyle()` key that is not a descriptor, a value with `var()` (descriptors cannot read custom properties), an empty or runtime value, or a system without what it needs: `symbols`, or `additiveSymbols` for `additive`, and neither for `extends`. |
| KRN1301 | `unknown-condition` | error | A key that is neither a property nor a condition, usually a condition at the top level (`":hover": {…}`). Conditions go inside the value: `color: { base: a, ":hover": b }`. |
| KRN1302 | `ambiguous-precedence` | warning | Two conditions of the same kind can match together with different values and nothing orders them. Nest one inside the other, or list the pair in `conditions.exclusive` when they never match together. Do not re-level it to hide the tie. |
| KRN1303 | `unsupported-contextual-target` | error | A `select.descendant()`/`select.child()` target must be one compound selector: an element name, attribute selectors and pseudo-classes. |
| KRN1401 | `relation-without-anchor` | error | A style reads a relation whose `anchor` is never applied, so it can never match. Apply `rel.anchor` on the element whose state is read. |
| KRN1402 | `relation-unused` | warning | A relation is anchored but never read. Remove the anchor, or read it with `within`/`after`/`before`. |
| KRN1403 | `relation-placement` | error | A relation is read from a position its anchor cannot be in (`within` needs the anchor on an ancestor, `after` on an earlier sibling). Move the anchor or use the other read. |
| KRN1404 | `relation-name-collision` | error | Two modules declare a relation with one name, so they share a marker. Declare it once, export it, and import it where it is read. |
| KRN1501 | `unknown-token` | error | The token group has no token by that name. Check the name against `kirana-style export`. |
| KRN1502 | `token-namespace-collision` | error | Two modules declare one token namespace. Give each `defineTokens()` its own namespace. |
| KRN1503 | `variable-default-scope` | warning | Reserved, not emitted yet: a variable token's default reads a custom property that exists only on a descendant. Assign the value on the element that owns it. |
| KRN1504 | `dynamic-token` | error | A token value is not known at build time. Token values must be static; bridge runtime values in the style instead. |
| KRN1505 | `unsupported-dtcg-type` | error | Reserved, not emitted yet (DTCG import is not built): a DTCG token type the importer does not map. Convert it to a plain value. |
| KRN1506 | `token-not-variable` | error | A theme overrides, or a style needs to vary, a token declared without `{ variable: true }`. Declare it as a variable token. |
| KRN1601 | `dynamic-bridged` | info | Info: a runtime value became a custom property and an inline `style`. Fine for continuous values; a few known values are cheaper as variants. |
| KRN1602 | `branch-budget-exceeded` | error | Too many runtime branches in one style. Split it into separate handles, or raise `dynamic.branchBudget`. |
| KRN1603 | `dynamic-key` | error | A property or condition key known only at runtime. Use a fixed key and put the choice in the value. |
| KRN1604 | `dynamic-spread` | error | A runtime object spread into a style. Declare the properties explicitly. |
| KRN1605 | `dynamic-variant` | info | Info: a recipe call with a runtime option resolves through the runtime table. Pass literal options where you can. |
| KRN1701 | `unused-sx` | warning | A component takes `sx` and never applies it. Pass it on: `sx={[styles.root, sx]}`, and take it out of a rest spread. |
| KRN1702 | `utility-surface-disabled` | error | A string `sx` without a utility grammar. Add a preset that declares one (`presets: [scales()]`), or write `css({…})`. |
| KRN1703 | `sx-on-external-component` | warning | `sx` given to a component from an installed package, which does not read it. Spread `{...styleProps(a, sx)}` (`props as styleProps` from `@kirana-style/core`) instead. |
| KRN1704 | `unknown-utility` | error | A utility the configured grammar does not know. Check the name, or write the style as an object. |
| KRN1705 | `unknown-utility-variant` | error | A utility variant the grammar does not declare. Declare it under `utilities.variants`, or write the condition in an object. |
| KRN1706 | `utility-not-static` | error | An interpolated utility string. Write whole strings, or an object with the value. |
| KRN1707 | `utility-unsupported` | error | A utility feature Kirana does not have (`!important`, two pseudo-elements). The precedence ladder decides; see `kirana-style trace`. |
| KRN1801 | `unknown-variant` | error | A recipe call names a variant group or option the recipe does not have. Check it against the recipe (`kirana-style export` lists them). |
| KRN1802 | `unknown-slot` | error | A recipe names a slot not listed in `slots`. Add it to `slots`, or fix the key. |
| KRN1901 | `invalid-config` | error | `kirana.config.*` does not match the schema. The message names the key. |
| KRN1902 | `target-lowering` | info | Info: the stylesheet is lowered for browser targets below the default floor. Expected when you set old targets. |
| KRN1903 | `class-name-collision` | error | Two different atoms hashed to one class name. The build cannot be trusted: report it with `kirana-style doctor --report`. |
| KRN1904 | `classes-not-static` | error | A module listed in `classes.modules` exports a style with no class string a template can use. Export static handles. |
| KRN1905 | `unknown-class-name` | error | A template asks the class map for a style it does not list. Export it from a module in `classes.modules`, or fix the name. |
